name: Archmage
focus: One huge hit, built from flammability, Lotus and repeats.
about: Plays for one enormous hit. Fire makes the Guardian more flammable, Lotus becomes big extra damage on a single blow, and Focus makes your skills repeat.
lore: The Archmages of the old Sun Court held that a spell should be spoken once and never answered. They trained to pour a whole ritual into a single word, and their towers still bear the scorch of it.

signature.name: Ember Echo
signature.text: The last fire skill before it in the ritual echoes once more, with its hits and effects. 20% more damage for each Focus held; at full Focus the echo repeats. Spends all Focus.

capstones.name: Starfall
capstones.text: Capstone. You can hold up to 3 Lotus. Convergence spends them all at once and deals 50% more damage for each Lotus after the first (200% more damage with 3 Lotus).

capstones.name: Twin Sun
capstones.text: Capstone. The skill with the highest Charge cost in your ritual always repeats, and the repeat deals 100% more damage on its first hit.

nodes.name: Arcane Focus
nodes.text: Each cast that does not crit gives 1 Focus. At 3 Focus, your next skill repeats and Focus resets.

nodes.name: Pyre Lotus
nodes.text: +50% flammability cap (200% total), and fire hits build flammability 30% faster. When a fire hit lands on a Guardian at 200% flammability or more, gain 1 Lotus (once per cast).

nodes.name: Second Incantation
nodes.text: Single-hit skills have +10% chance to repeat.

nodes.name: Convergence
nodes.text: Spending Lotus no longer makes the hit crit. Instead the skill deals 100% more damage on its first hit, and its other hits deal no damage. Every element can spend Lotus, fire included.

nodes.name: Quick Focus
nodes.text: Focus is full at 2 instead of 3.

nodes.name: Echoing Mind
nodes.text: When a skill repeats, the repeat deals 45% more damage.

nodes.name: Rime Lens
nodes.text: Unlocks the rite Rime Lens (buff, 2 Charge): gain 1 Lotus that any element can spend on its next skill. Each Lotus you spend also gives 1 Focus.

tree.name: Arcane Focus

art.name: Sunfall
art.short: A pillar of sunlight, a rain of meteors, a falling sun
art.text: The sky catches fire. A pillar of sunlight strikes first and carries your Lotus, then meteors rain down, more for every Focus and Lotus you hold, until a falling sun ends it. It fills with every Focus double cast and Convergence since the last release. Your Lotus and Focus start over.
art.lore: The Sun Court sealed one spell beneath every tower: the sun itself, asked to fall. No Archmage has spoken it twice.

name: Spellblade
focus: Crits through many hits, built from Momentum and Scar.
about: Plays for crits through many small hits. Momentum makes every hit in a cast sharper than the last, and every crit cuts a Scar into the Guardian that makes later crits deadlier.
lore: Spellblades learned magic on the duelling floor, not in the library. They carve their spells into the steel and let the blade speak them, one cut after another, until the enemy is more wound than flesh.

signature.name: Gale Step
signature.text: A wind-blade dash: 1 cut, plus 1 for every 5 Scar (5 at 20), up to twice the damage at 20 Scar. Each cut has +30% crit chance and builds Momentum. Spends all Scar; each cut that crits leaves 1 Scar.

capstones.name: Flurry of Steel
capstones.text: Capstone. Momentum no longer resets between casts. It builds up to 14 hits, for up to +70% crit chance.

capstones.name: Thousand Cuts
capstones.text: Capstone. Once the Guardian has 15 Scar, every non-fire hit crits for the rest of the ritual, and your crits deal 70% more damage.

nodes.name: Blade Dance
nodes.text: Momentum gives each hit after the first in a cast +5% crit chance, adding up (fire hits cannot crit). Each crit leaves 1 Scar on the Guardian (max 20). At 3 Scar, the Guardian's crit reduction stops working. Your crits deal 1.5% more damage per Scar (30% more damage at 20 Scar).

nodes.name: Quickening
nodes.text: Skills that hit more than once hit 1 more time.

nodes.name: Open Wound
nodes.text: At 10 Scar or more, your crits ignore 25% of the Guardian's armour and resistance.

nodes.name: Keen Rhythm
nodes.text: Momentum also gives +7% crit damage and +8% ailment effect (bleed, Shock, chill and the rest) for each hit before it in the cast.

nodes.name: Blood Edge
nodes.text: Each Scar on the Guardian gives you +2% crit damage (up to +40% at 20 Scar).

nodes.name: Glacial Focus
nodes.text: Unlocks the rite Glacial Focus (buff, 3 Charge): your next 3 casts have +20% crit chance and +30% crit damage. While it is active, each crit leaves 2 Scar instead of 1. Your crits also deal 0.6% more damage per Scar (12% more at 20 Scar).

nodes.name: Riposte
nodes.text: At 15 Scar or more, every 5th hit adds an extra slash that deals 160% of that hit's damage.

art.name: Bladestorm
art.short: Swords of ice, taken one by one, then one slash that always crits
art.text: You become an aura of ice that burns like fire. Spectral swords hang around the Guardian, one for every few Scar; the aura takes them one by one and cuts from the front, the right, above and the left. When the last sword is spent, one huge slash always hits and always crits, with ten times your crit chance and twice your crit damage. Your Scar and Momentum start over.
art.lore: The duelling floors kept one form off the record: the form where the blade stops waiting for the hand.

name: Warlock
focus: Ignite and poison saved in a bank, set off by Withering Hex.
about: Plays for burn and poison together. Every ignite and poison you apply is saved in a bank. Withering Hex sets the whole bank off at once, and each Brimstone makes the blast bigger.
lore: Warlocks made a pact with the sulfur that sleeps under the Planes. It keeps every burn and every venom they lay, and pays it all back at once when they speak the Hex.

signature.name: Brimstone Rupture
signature.text: Two bursts, fire then poison, up to twice the damage at full Brimstone. Spends all Brimstone (the bank stays) and Exposes the Guardian for your next cast: 20% increased damage taken.

capstones.name: Apocalypse
capstones.text: Capstone. The last Withering Hex of the ritual Invokes twice, both at full strength. The first Invoke keeps the bank, the second spends it.

capstones.name: Pandemonium
capstones.text: Capstone. For 3 casts after each Invoke, every fire hit poisons and every chaos hit ignites.

nodes.name: Brimstone Pact
nodes.text: Unlocks the rite Withering Hex. The base damage of every ignite and poison you apply is also saved in a bank that never fades (your ignite and poison damage bonuses count for a quarter there). A hit that applies ignite and poison together, or one of them while the other is on the Guardian, gives +1 Brimstone (max 10). Casting Withering Hex Invokes the bank: all of it hits at once, with 15% more damage per Brimstone, against the lower of fire and chaos resistance. Then the bank and Brimstone empty. Fire hits on a poisoned Guardian have 30% chance to poison, and chaos hits on a burning Guardian have 30% chance to ignite. Combust gives +2 Brimstone instead of exploding.

nodes.name: Hex Weaver
nodes.text: Withering Hex costs 1 Charge instead of 2 and lasts 1 more cast.

nodes.name: Venomfire
nodes.text: A hit that applies ignite and poison together gives +1 more Brimstone. While both are on the Guardian, their ticks deal 30% more damage.

nodes.name: Smouldering Ruin
nodes.text: After an Invoke, 60% of the bank stays instead of emptying. Talents that expose the Guardian or detonate poison also Invoke, at 50% of the bank and without emptying it.

nodes.name: Flame of Ruin
nodes.text: Invoke deals more damage the more flammable the Guardian is: 1.2% more per 1% flammability (180% more damage at 150% flammability).

nodes.name: Sulfur Blood
nodes.text: +5 max Brimstone (15 total). Ignite and poison are saved in the bank at 110% of their damage.

nodes.name: Festering Hex
nodes.text: While the Guardian is Exposed, every Brimstone gain is 1 higher.

art.name: Hellgate
art.short: The bank pours out as fire and poison
art.text: A violet void gate tears open over the Guardian, crackling with lightning, and pours your whole Brimstone bank through it. Your bank and Brimstone start over.
art.lore: The pact had one clause in small letters: the sulfur may be called up all at once, but the gate does not close politely.

name: Alchemist
focus: Poison stacks into the teens, blasted in one hit after the last cast.
about: Plays for a mountain of poison. Stacks no longer expire and up to 25 can pile up. After your last cast, everything left on the Guardian detonates in one hit.
lore: Alchemists distil patience. Every drop they lay waits, quiet and growing, and when the work is done they light the last flask and let the whole brew answer at once.

signature.name: Volatile Flask
signature.text: A flask adds 10 poison stacks, and a quarter of the stacks on the Guardian detonate at once without being removed: from 1.4 times the damage with none, to twice at full stacks.

capstones.name: Magnum Opus
capstones.text: Capstone. The final detonation deals 11% more damage per poison stack (275% more damage at 25 stacks).

capstones.name: Toxic Apotheosis
capstones.text: Capstone. The final detonation ignores chaos resistance. It also deals 55% more damage for each time you applied Corrosion during the ritual (275% more damage after 5 Corrosions).

nodes.name: Dormant Venom
nodes.text: Poison stacks no longer expire, but while they wait they tick for 50% less damage. +5 max poison stacks (15 total). After your last cast, all damage over time left on the Guardian is dealt at once in one hit, at full strength.

nodes.name: Virulent Mist
nodes.text: +90% poison chance and +5 max poison stacks, but your poison deals 25% less damage. Hits are not affected.

nodes.name: Venom Edge
nodes.text: On physical skills, all your bonus poison chance also adds to your bleed chance, and bleed chance above 100% applies extra bleeds. Every bleed you apply also leaves a poison stack worth 150% of the bleed’s damage. If your bleeds already turn into poison, that poison deals 60% more damage instead.

nodes.name: Overdose
nodes.text: +25% poison chance. Poison chance above 100% no longer adds damage. Instead, each hit applies 1 stack for every full 100% poison chance, and the rest is a chance for one more. +5 max poison stacks.

nodes.name: Catalyst
nodes.text: Every 10 poison stacks you apply set off a blast that deals 40% of all damage over time on the Guardian, without removing it.

nodes.name: Venom Coat
nodes.text: Unlocks the rite Venom Coat (buff, 3 Charge): every hit, of any element, has 35% chance to poison. It lasts 2 more casts, and with Overdose its chance adds to your poison chance.

nodes.name: Fermented Burst
nodes.text: Talents that detonate poison no longer remove it, and the final detonation deals 25% more damage.

art.name: The Great Work
art.text: The last flask floods the Guardian with 75 poison stacks past the cap. They wait without ticking and detonate after the last cast of the ritual, with Magnum Opus. Your poison starts over.
art.lore: Every Alchemist works toward one recipe and hopes never to finish it. The last flask is not poured, it is surrendered.

name: Oracle
focus: A long ritual with 8 slots, cheaper Charge and lasting buffs.
about: Plays for a long ritual. An extra slot, cheaper Charge and three buff rites. Omen keeps your buffs alive longer, and the late casts hit hardest.
lore: Oracles read the ritual before it is spoken. They light one candle for every blessing they will need, and when the last candle burns, the future they read comes true.

signature.name: Augury
signature.text: Gain 1 Omen and strike once, with 25% more damage for each different buff active. Your buffs keep the cast they would have spent.

capstones.name: Prophecy
capstones.text: Capstone. After your last cast, the strongest cast of the ritual repeats once, with every buff still active.

capstones.name: Eternal Blessing
capstones.text: Capstone. Each time Omen fills, every active buff gains +1 cast and becomes 15% stronger for the rest of the ritual. This stacks.

nodes.name: Omen
nodes.text: +1 ritual slot, free to open (8 with the Warden's Chronicle set). +3 Charge. Ritual slots 4, 5 and 6 and rites cost 2 Charge less (min 0). Deal 30% more damage for each different buff active when you cast. Gain 1 Omen for each rite you cast and for each cast made with a buff active (max 3). The cast that fills Omen does not use up its buffs, then Omen resets.

nodes.name: Kindled Will
nodes.text: Unlocks the rite Kindled Will (buff, 3 Charge): your next 3 casts deal 80% more hit damage.

nodes.name: Battle Trance
nodes.text: Unlocks the rite Battle Trance (buff, 3 Charge): your next 3 casts gain +70% base damage. Base damage counts before every other bonus, so it raises hits and damage over time alike.

nodes.name: Crescendo
nodes.text: From your 6th cast on, each cast deals 30% more damage than the one before, up to 90% more damage on the 8th.

nodes.name: Harmony
nodes.text: Deal 20% more damage for each different buff active when you cast (60% more damage with 3 buffs).

nodes.name: Choir
nodes.text: Rite effects are 10% stronger.

nodes.name: Echo Spark
nodes.text: Unlocks the rite Echo Spark (buff, 5 Charge): your next 3 casts have 15% chance to repeat. Every repeat, from any source, gives 1 Omen.

art.name: The Last Prophecy
art.short: Lightning, ice and fire strike the Guardian
art.text: Lightning scatters, and ice and fire slash the Guardian: one strike for every Omen fill and buff. Your Omen starts over.
art.lore: Oracles read every future but one. The Last Prophecy is read aloud only when there is no future left to read.
